description: Searches every FHA-insured hospital loan in HUD's files (Section 242, 223(f), 223(a)(7) and 241(a)): the active loans or the terminated ones since 1968, filtered by hospital, system or city name, state, program, status (including loans that ended in an insurance claim) and endorsement years. Returns FHA number, hospital, program, amount, note rate, dates, balance or how the loan ended, and the hospital page link.

program.description: FHA program: 242 (construction or renovation), 223(f) (refinance or purchase), 223(a)(7) (refinance of an FHA loan), 241(a) (supplemental).

query.description: Words from a hospital, health system or city name, e.g. "Kaleida" or "Beaumont".

sort.description: Order by initial endorsement date or by original amount.

state.description: Two-letter state or territory code, e.g. NY.

status.description: active = in HUD's active file; terminated = ended loans; claims = terminations HUD types as a claim; all = both files.

name: search_hospital_loans
title: Search FHA-insured hospital loans
